title: What is the Mizaj Deck?
caption:
16 types × 4 elements = 64 cards. Here's how the Mizaj Deck works.

Your type is how you think. Your element is how you run. Put them together and you get your card, like The Trustee · Fire or The Life of the Party · Water. Every card has an element it works best with, and an opposite to tag.

Pull yours, then collect your friends'. Comment your card below.
